definitions.gloss: first appearance; debut performance; first time appearing (in a show, film, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The first time a person appears in a particular show, film, play, or other performance. Often used in entertainment news.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{初出演|はつしゅつえん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made my first TV appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{初出演|はつしゅつえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: She played the lead role in her first movie appearance.

examples.japanese: {初出演|はつしゅつえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高視聴率|こうしちょうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}して→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧、⟦{一躍|いちやく}→一躍：11183_ichiyaku⟧⟦{人気者|にんきもの}→人気者：19887_ninkimono⟧になった。
examples.english: The drama of her debut appearance recorded high ratings, and she became an overnight sensation.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧ (first) and ⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧ (appearance, performance). Commonly used in entertainment journalism and celebrity news. Can function as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初出演|はつしゅつえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make one's first appearance
- ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧{初出演|はつしゅつえん}: first TV appearance
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{初出演|はつしゅつえん}: first movie appearance
- ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧{初出演|はつしゅつえん}: first stage appearance

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧: appearance, performance
- ⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧: debut — loanword with broader usage beyond performance
- {初登場|はつとうじょう}: first appearance — used more broadly, including for characters and products
- ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧～: prefix meaning "first" — productive prefix: ⟦{初出場|はつしゅつじょう}→初出場：26884_hatsushutsujou⟧ (first tournament entry), {初主演|はつしゅえん} (first lead role)
